description: BLAST-Lite is the National Laboratory of the Rockies' collection of battery degradation models fitted to laboratory ageing tests. Python and MATLAB implementations estimate cell lifetime from temperature, state of charge, depth of discharge and charge/discharge rates. Outputs describe expected degradation under configured electric-vehicle or stationary-storage operation. Coverage is cell-specific, with models trained on roughly one to three years of accelerated testing and often extrapolated to longer lifetimes. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause with installation instructions and application examples. A limitation is that these qualitative lifetime estimates omit physical damage, overcharge, humidity and pack imbalance; the authors distinguish expected life from warranty life. The collection can compare storage sizing and operating strategies in infrastructure simulations. PyBaMM (platform-pybamm) supplies related electrochemical modelling. Climate and usage profiles remain separate inputs with their own provenance. No battery data or model files were downloaded.
